text: Query and combine data from multiple data sources to build alerts across metrics and logs
quote: you create queries and expressions from multiple data sources, no matter where you store your data, giving you the flexibility to combine your data and alert on your metrics and logs in new and unique ways

text: Create, manage, and act on alerts from one consolidated view
quote: create, manage, and take action on your alerts from a single, consolidated view

text: Query, visualize, alert on, and explore metrics, logs, and traces wherever they are stored
quote: enables you to query, visualize, alert on, and explore your metrics, logs, and traces wherever they're stored

text: Provision data sources and dashboards from version-controlled config files (GitOps)
quote: Grafana has an active provisioning system that uses configuration files. You can define data sources and dashboards using files that can be version controlled, making GitOps more natural.

text: Define dashboards and configs as code with version control, testing, and CI/CD deployment
quote: This approach lets you define dashboards, data sources, and other configurations in code, enabling version control, automated testing, and reliable deployments through CI/CD pipelines.

text: Search traces, generate metrics from spans, and link traces with logs and metrics (Tempo)
quote: Tempo lets you search for traces, generate metrics from spans, and link your tracing data with logs and metrics.

text: Define and measure SLOs/SLIs to track service quality
quote: Grafana SLO (Service Level Objective) provides a framework for measuring the quality of service you provide to users.

text: Create on-call schedules, escalate alerts, and coordinate incidents end-to-end
quote: create on-call schedules, escalate alerts to the people who are on call, and coordinate incidents from declaration through post-incident review

text: Connect AI agents to Grafana via a hosted or self-managed MCP Server
quote: Connect AI agents to Grafana through the fully hosted Cloud MCP Server or the self-managed open source MCP Server.

text: Understand production systems faster using natural language
quote: Understand production systems faster using natural language

text: Explore data with ad-hoc queries, dynamic drilldown, and side-by-side comparisons
quote: Explore your data through ad-hoc queries and dynamic drilldown. Split view and compare different time ranges, queries and data sources side by side.

text: Switch from metrics to logs while preserving label filters for correlated exploration
quote: Experience the magic of switching from metrics to logs with preserved label filters. Quickly search through all your logs or streaming them live.

text: Build dynamic, reusable dashboards using template variable dropdowns
quote: Create dynamic & reusable dashboards with template variables that appear as dropdowns at the top of the dashboard.

text: Mix multiple data sources, including custom ones, within the same graph on a per-query basis
quote: Mix different data sources in the same graph! You can specify a data source on a per-query basis. This works for even custom datasources.

text: Free tier available for personal projects and early-stage use with no charges
quote: Perfect for personal projects, exploring new ideas, and early-stage startups. No charges ever.

text: Adaptive Telemetry automatically identifies important data and aggregates the rest to cut telemetry costs up to 80%
quote: Grafana Cloud’s Adaptive Telemetry suite automatically identifies the data worth your attention and aggregates the rest, cutting your telemetry costs by up to 80%.

text: LogQL query language uses labels and operators to filter logs
quote: LogQL is Grafana Loki's query language. LogQL uses labels and operators for filtering.

text: Alerting notifies you moments after problems occur in your systems
quote: Grafana Alerting allows you to learn about problems in your systems moments after they occur.

text: Jump from Prometheus metric exemplars directly to related Tempo traces
quote: Prometheus exemplars let you jump from Prometheus metrics to Tempo traces by clicking on recorded exemplars.

text: Official CLI lets you authenticate, manage multiple environments, and run admin tasks, suited for CI/CD and local dev
quote: You can authenticate, manage multiple environments, and perform administrative tasks from the terminal. It’s suitable for CI/CD pipelines, local development

text: Investigate incidents using the same correlated metrics, logs, and traces that triggered the alert
quote: During an incident, you can investigate with the same metrics, logs, and traces that fired the alert.

text: Run Loki locally in single-binary mode with a local filesystem backend for quick experimentation
quote: Try it locally. The fastest way to experiment is to run Loki in monolithic (single-binary) mode with a local filesystem backend and send logs to it with Grafana Alloy.

text: Act on alerts and declare/manage incidents from Slack, Microsoft Teams, or the Grafana mobile app
quote: From Slack, Microsoft Teams, or the Grafana mobile app, you can act on those alerts and declare and manage incidents.

text: Forecast metrics and detect anomalies with automated dynamic-threshold alerting
quote: Forecast metrics, detect anomalies, and run automated investigations with Sift to alert on dynamic thresholds and surface likely causes.

text: Run automated investigations (Sift) to surface likely root causes of alerts
quote: Forecast metrics, detect anomalies, and run automated investigations with Sift to alert on dynamic thresholds and surface likely causes.

text: Send alert notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, and OpsGenie
quote: Grafana will continuously evaluate and send notifications to systems like Slack, PagerDuty, VictorOps, OpsGenie.

text: Supports migrating from previous deployments and upgrading Loki environments
quote: migrate from previous deployments, and upgrade your Loki environment
